attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Georgia state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per OCGA § 48-7-20: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 5.39%. Standard deductions: $12,000 Single/MFS, $24,000 MFJ/QSS, $18,000 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Georgia Tax Calculation (top marginal 5.39%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
Filing status is Head of Household

policy_statement.policy_description: GA MFJ: 5.39% x max(AGI - $24,000, 0) per OCGA § 48-7-20
GA HOH: 5.39% x max(AGI - $18,000, 0) per OCGA § 48-7-20
GA Single/MFS: 5.39% x max(AGI - $12,000, 0) per OCGA § 48-7-20
